An '''Assistant Minister of Internal Affairs''' was a position in the [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] government. [[Ruto Graven]] held the position when the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invaded]] Naboo in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].
